contract: ../DESIGN.md v1.6 overview contract; shared original instruments, 26 widgets, validated local layout, original racing branding and data-driven/reduced motion.

accessibility.evidence: Native labeled width/height selectors, touch/keyboard up/down buttons, focusable grid and overflow bodies. Grid DOM order matches layout order; no duplicate IDs across all 26 widgets. RTL controls and label restoration inspected. Full screen-reader QA remains unperformed.

responsive.evidence: Drive/Engineering/All tested at five sizes with extra-large values: no horizontal document/grid/widget-shell overflow. Phones stack at full width and preserve saved desktop dimensions. Final engineering first row checked at 1440 after balancing its widths.

loading.evidence: Dashboard mounts original nodes before gauges/schema initialization; 88 raw rows populate and all IDs remain connected.

empty.evidence: No packets show waiting/em dashes. Explicit empty layout releases every borrowed node, shows Add/Reset recovery and was restored using Add widget.

error.evidence: Forced isolated storage write failure showed the temporary-layout message while instruments remained usable. Layout tests reject invalid/oversized/unknown input.

partial.evidence: Populated isolated fixture exercises numeric/vehicle/tire rendering; missing live history remains unavailable. Fixture clearly labeled, receiver receives no synthetic packets, and fixture cleared by reload.

success.evidence: 29 tests pass. GUI move/resize persisted 8-column/480px Engine across reload. Native DataTransfer drag handlers moved car ahead of engine. All widgets preserved original canvas identity; returning to Chassis restored two front/two rear cards.

permission.reason: Widget layout, branding and motion use local DOM/localStorage only; no new browser/system permissions or network exposure.
